modmenu.descriptionTranslation.villager_: Places and breaks a lectern automatically until a librarian offers the enchanted book you want.
villager_gacha.msg.started: Started. Press %s for an emergency stop.
villager_gacha.msg.resume_manually: Fix the problem, then press %s to resume.
villager_gacha.msg.auto_resume: Resuming automatically in %s s (%s/%s). Press %s to cancel.
villager_gacha.msg.auto_resume_gave_up: Gave up auto-resuming after too many failures in a row. Press %s to resume.
villager_gacha.msg.need_lectern: No lectern left. It will continue as soon as a lectern is in your inventory.
villager_gacha.msg.found: Found %s after %s pulls! %s target(s) left - go to another villager and press start.
villager_gacha.msg.found_last: Found %s after %s pulls! All targets are done.
villager_gacha.error.no_targets: No target books. Add some with the target list.
villager_gacha.error.no_spot: No lectern spot. Look at the spot and press %s.
villager_gacha.error.no_villager: No villager near the lectern spot.
villager_gacha.error.spot_blocked: Something is in the way at the lectern spot.
villager_gacha.error.place_failed: Could not place the lectern. Is it within reach?
villager_gacha.error.break_failed: Could not break the lectern. Is it within reach?
villager_gacha.error.job_locked: The villager keeps its job. It was probably traded with already (can't be reset), or another job site block is nearby.
villager_gacha.error.axe_worn: Every axe in the hotbar has %s durability or less. Repair or swap the axe, then resume.
villager_gacha.error.no_trade_screen: The trade screen won't open. If other villagers are nearby, stand closest to the one you want to use. A server plugin may also be blocking it.
villager_gacha.error.no_trade_screen_far: The trade screen won't open: the villager is out of reach. Stand within 3 blocks of it.
villager_gacha.status.need_lectern: Waiting for a lectern (pick one up)
villager_gacha.status.villager_sleeping: The villager is asleep. Waiting for it to wake up...
villager_gacha.status.await_jobless: Waiting for the villager to lose its job...
villager_gacha.hud.title: VillagerGacha
villager_gacha.ui.targets.title: Target Books
villager_gacha.ui.targets.hint: Checked top to bottom. Whether found books are removed can be set in Settings.
villager_gacha.ui.targets.empty: No targets yet. Add one with the buttons below.
villager_gacha.ui.cheapest.tooltip: ON: only accept the lowest price possible for that level (2 + 3×Lv emeralds, doubled for treasure enchantments like Mending). Reputation discounts are ignored.
villager_gacha.ui.add_any.tooltip: Adds a target that accepts any enchanted book offered at its cheapest possible price.
villager_gacha.ui.settings.title: Settings
villager_gacha.ui.spot.set.tooltip: Looking at a lectern uses that lectern. Otherwise the space in front of the face you look at (look at the floor to use the block above it).
villager_gacha.ui.break_delay.tooltip: Extra time between closing the trade screen and breaking the lectern. 0 is fine normally; increase only if it fails on a laggy server.
villager_gacha.ui.place_delay.tooltip: The lectern is placed again as soon as the villager loses its job. This adds extra time on top of that. 0 is fine normally.
villager_gacha.ui.face_targets.tooltip: Turns your view toward the lectern / villager before using it. Try this only if a server plugin or anti-cheat blocks it.
villager_gacha.ui.remove_found.tooltip: ON: when a target is found, it is removed from the list. OFF: it stays in the list, so you can go to another villager and look for the same book again.
villager_gacha.ui.hide_trade_screen.tool: While running, the villager's trades are read without showing the trade screen. (The game only sends trades when you talk to the villager, so it still talks to it in the background.)
villager_gacha.ui.open_delay.tooltip: Extra time between the villager becoming a librarian and talking to it. 0 is fine normally; increase only if the trade won't open on your server.
villager_gacha.ui.show_hud.tooltip: Show the status panel while running.
villager_gacha.ui.chat.tooltip: Only found books are written to chat by default. Other messages appear briefly above the hotbar.
villager_gacha.ui.hud.tooltip: Show the status panel while running, where to show it, and how big it is.
villager_gacha.ui.hud_position.tooltip: Where the status panel is shown. Click to switch.
villager_gacha.ui.hud_scale.tooltip: Size of the status panel. Click to switch. It snaps to the nearest size where text stays sharp.
villager_gacha.ui.protect_axe.tooltip: When ON, axes with this much durability left or less are not used. If every axe in the hotbar is worn out, it stops before breaking the lectern.
villager_gacha.ui.auto_resume.tooltip: When it pauses for a recoverable reason (villager not found, lectern couldn't be broken, ...), resume automatically after a while.
villager_gacha.ui.auto_resume_wait.toolt: How long to wait before resuming automatically.
villager_gacha.ui.auto_resume_limit.tool: Give up after this many failures in a row. The count resets whenever trades are checked.
